title: OmniParser: screenshot UI parsing so general LLMs can click screens
summary: OmniParser parses screenshots into labeled UI elements so general-purpose models (GPT-4o, DeepSeek R1, Qwen2.5VL) can click accurately instead of guessing coordinates. Paired with OmniTool it controls a Windows 11 VM; Hugging Face Spaces hosts a live demo.
question_it_answers: How can a general LLM click UI elements without a native computer-use model?

claims.text: OmniParser converts screenshots into structured, labeled UI elements for click targeting.
claims.evidence: It parses a screenshot into structured, labeled UI elements, buttons, icons, text fields
claims.subject: mcp-and-agent-browsers

claims.text: OmniTool with OmniParser can control an actual Windows 11 VM using OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, or Claude Computer Use.
claims.evidence: Paired with OmniTool, it can control an actual Windows 11 VM, works with OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, or Anthropic's Claude Computer Use.
claims.subject: mcp-and-agent-browsers

media.description: Screen recording demo of OmniParser labeling UI elements on a Windows desktop for agent clicking.
